hero.title: WaVio
hero.subtitle: Trigger from Hand Gestures
hero.body: Control your media with acoustic sensing. No touch needed—just wave your hand through the air while enjoying the serene aquarium backdrop.

architect.subtitle: AI Solutions Architect // Systems Integration Expert

solution.title: Solution & Architecture
solution.content: Binary Acoustic Logic (The Sonar Engine) Instead of relying on heavy visual machine learning, WaVio utilizes a custom pure-JavaScript Web Audio engine. It broadcasts an inaudible 19kHz sine wave and actively listens for frequency anomalies or physical device telemetry.

empathy.title: Empathetic Engineering
empathy.subtitle: Focus Mode
empathy.content: Designed for specialized accessibility. 'Focus Mode' locks the UI to prevent accidental touches, translating gross-motor movements into media rewinds and play/pause commands.

future.title: Future Scope: The AI Horizon
future.content: WaVio is built as a foundational physical interface for next-gen AI like Google Project Astra. Silent Spatial Computing and the WaveSynch Cast Protocol will bridge local DOM events with the Google Cast SDK.

architect.techSpecs:

🔹 Eco-Tank: Global state monitors battery/thermal APIs.
